title.narrative: Gender Responsive Governance - support to UN Women Strategic Note 2023-2027

description.narrative:
The grant is “Thematic support at country level (Type A support) towards UN Women India Country office’s Strategic Note 2023 to 2027 (SN 2023-27) Outcome 2.
Impact: Women and girls in India will benefit from decent work and economic opportunities and increased economic, social and political autonomy, live lives free from violence and discrimination and lead and participate equally in political leadership and public life and benefit from gender responsive institutions with enhanced resilience to disasters.
Main objective of SN 2023-27 is aligned with the UNSDCF 2023-27 and focuses on gender responsive governance, women’s economic empowerment, and ending violence against women. It commits to supporting India’s women-led development, including economic empowerment, bridging the gender digital divide, and driving gender-inclusive climate action.
